stem: According to Article II of the 1987 Constitution, where does sovereignty reside?
explanation: Article II, Section 1 declares the Philippines a democratic and republican State in which sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them.
quote: Sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them.

stem: The 1987 Constitution states that civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over the:
explanation: Article II, Section 3 establishes civilian supremacy: civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over the military.
quote: Civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over the military.

stem: Under Article II, Section 2, the Philippines renounces war as:
explanation: Article II, Section 2 states that the Philippines renounces war as an instrument of national policy and adopts the generally accepted principles of international law.
quote: The Philippines renounces war as an instrument of national policy

stem: Which principle does Article II, Section 6 of the Constitution declare inviolable?
choices: The separation of Church and State
explanation: Article II, Section 6 provides that the separation of Church and State shall be inviolable.
quote: The separation of Church and State shall be inviolable.

stem: Article II, Section 27 directs the State to maintain honesty and integrity in the public service and to take positive and effective measures against:
explanation: Section 27 of Article II commits the State to honesty and integrity in the public service and to positive and effective measures against graft and corruption.
quote: The State shall maintain honesty and integrity in the public service and take positive and effective measures against graft and corruption.

stem: Article II, Section 28 commits the State to a policy of full public disclosure of all its transactions involving:
explanation: Subject to reasonable conditions prescribed by law, the State adopts and implements a policy of full public disclosure of all its transactions involving public interest.
quote: full public disclosure of all its transactions involving public interest

stem: Article II, Section 12 directs the State to equally protect the life of the mother and the life of the unborn from:
explanation: Section 12 of Article II provides that the State shall equally protect the life of the mother and the life of the unborn from conception.
quote: the life of the unborn from conception

stem: Article II, Section 14 of the Constitution directs the State to ensure the fundamental equality before the law of:
explanation: Section 14 recognizes the role of women in nation-building and directs the State to ensure the fundamental equality before the law of women and men.
quote: the fundamental equality before the law of women and men

stem: Under Article I, the waters around, between, and connecting the islands of the archipelago form part of the Philippines':
explanation: Article I states that these waters, regardless of their breadth and dimensions, form part of the internal waters of the Philippines (the archipelagic doctrine).
quote: The waters around, between, and connecting the islands of the archipelago, regardless of their breadth and dimensions, form part of the internal waters of the Philippines.

stem: In its Preamble, whose aid do the sovereign Filipino people implore?
explanation: The Preamble begins: "We, the sovereign Filipino people, imploring the aid of Almighty God..."
quote: imploring the aid of Almighty God

stem: Article III, Section 1 provides that no person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without:
explanation: Section 1 of the Bill of Rights contains the due process and equal protection clauses.
quote: No person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law, nor shall any person be denied the equal protection of the laws.

stem: Under Article III, Section 2, probable cause for issuing a search warrant or warrant of arrest must be determined personally by:
explanation: No search warrant or warrant of arrest shall issue except upon probable cause to be determined personally by the judge after examining the complainant and witnesses under oath.
quote: probable cause to be determined personally by the judge

stem: Under Article III, Section 3, evidence obtained in violation of the privacy of communication and correspondence is:
choices: admissible if a court later approves it
inadmissible for any purpose in any proceeding
explanation: Section 3(2) of the Bill of Rights makes such evidence inadmissible for any purpose in any proceeding (the exclusionary rule).
quote: Any evidence obtained in violation of this or the preceding section shall be inadmissible for any purpose in any proceeding.

stem: Which right is protected by Article III, Section 4 of the Constitution?
choices: The right to a government job
The right to free college education
Freedom of speech, of expression, and of the press
explanation: Section 4 provides that no law shall be passed abridging the freedom of speech, of expression, or of the press, or the right of the people peaceably to assemble and petition the government for redress of grievances.
quote: No law shall be passed abridging the freedom of speech, of expression, or of the press, or the right of the people peaceably to assemble and petition the government for redress of grievances.

stem: Article III, Section 7 recognizes the right of the people to information on matters of:
explanation: Section 7 provides that the right of the people to information on matters of public concern shall be recognized, subject to limitations provided by law.
quote: The right of the people to information on matters of public concern shall be recognized.

stem: Under Article III, Section 9, private property shall not be taken for public use without:
explanation: Section 9 limits the power of eminent domain: private property may be taken for public use only with just compensation.
quote: Private property shall not be taken for public use without just compensation.

stem: Which of the following does Article III, Section 10 prohibit?
choices: A law impairing the obligation of contracts
explanation: Section 10 states that no law impairing the obligation of contracts shall be passed.
quote: No law impairing the obligation of contracts shall be passed.

stem: Under Article III, Section 12, a person under investigation for an offense has the right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel preferably:
choices: from the Public Attorney's Office only
explanation: Section 12 guarantees the right to remain silent and to competent and independent counsel preferably of the person's own choice (the Miranda rights).
quote: right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel preferably of his own choice

stem: Article III, Section 19 prohibits all of the following EXCEPT:
choices: Imposing the death penalty without a law passed for compelling reasons involving heinous crimes
explanation: Section 19(1) bars excessive fines and cruel, degrading or inhuman punishment, and bars the death penalty unless Congress provides for it for compelling reasons involving heinous crimes. Reasonable fines are not prohibited.
quote: Excessive fines shall not be imposed, nor cruel, degrading or inhuman punishment inflicted.

stem: According to Article III, Section 20, no person shall be imprisoned for:
choices: debt or non-payment of a poll tax
explanation: Section 20 provides that no person shall be imprisoned for debt or non-payment of a poll tax.
quote: No person shall be imprisoned for debt or non-payment of a poll tax.

stem: "No person shall be twice put in jeopardy of punishment for the same offense." This constitutional guarantee is known as the protection against:
explanation: Article III, Section 21 protects against being tried or punished twice for the same offense, known as double jeopardy.
quote: No person shall be twice put in jeopardy of punishment for the same offense.

stem: Article III, Section 22 prohibits the enactment of:
choices: ex post facto laws and bills of attainder
explanation: Section 22 states that no ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted.
quote: No ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted.

stem: Under Article IV, natural-born citizens are those who are citizens of the Philippines from birth:
choices: after taking an oath of allegiance before a Philippine consul abroad
without having to perform any act to acquire or perfect their citizenship
after electing Philippine citizenship upon reaching the age of majority
only if both of their parents are Filipino citizens at the time of birth
explanation: Article IV, Section 2 defines natural-born citizens as those who are citizens from birth without having to perform any act to acquire or perfect their citizenship.
quote: citizens of the Philippines from birth without having to perform any act to acquire or perfect their Philippine citizenship

stem: Under Article IV, Section 1, which of the following are citizens of the Philippines?
choices: Only those born on Philippine soil
Anyone who has lived in the Philippines for five years
Only those whose fathers are citizens
Those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines
explanation: Article IV, Section 1(2) includes those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines. Citizenship follows blood (jus sanguinis), through either parent.
quote: Those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines

stem: Under Article V, what is the minimum age to exercise the right of suffrage?
explanation: Article V, Section 1 grants suffrage to citizens not otherwise disqualified by law who are at least eighteen years of age and meet the residence requirements.
quote: at least eighteen years of age

stem: To vote, a citizen must have resided in the Philippines for at least one year and in the place where they propose to vote for at least how long immediately preceding the election?
explanation: Article V, Section 1 requires at least one year of residence in the Philippines and at least six months in the place where the voter proposes to vote.
quote: for at least six months immediately preceding the election

stem: Which requirement does Article V expressly forbid imposing on the exercise of suffrage?
explanation: Article V, Section 1 provides that no literacy, property, or other substantive requirement shall be imposed on the exercise of suffrage.
quote: No literacy, property, or other substantive requirement shall be imposed on the exercise of suffrage.

stem: How many Senators compose the Senate under the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Article VI, Section 2 provides that the Senate shall be composed of twenty-four Senators elected at large.
quote: The Senate shall be composed of twenty-four Senators who shall be elected at large by the qualified voters of the Philippines

stem: What is the minimum age requirement for a Senator on the day of the election?
explanation: Article VI, Section 3 requires a Senator to be at least thirty-five years of age on the day of the election.
quote: on the day of the election, is at least thirty-five years of age

stem: A Senator may serve for no more than how many consecutive terms?
explanation: Article VI, Section 4 provides that no Senator shall serve for more than two consecutive terms. A Senate term is six years.
quote: No Senator shall serve for more than two consecutive terms.

stem: What is the minimum age requirement for a Member of the House of Representatives?
explanation: Article VI, Section 6 requires a Member of the House to be at least twenty-five years of age on the day of the election.
quote: on the day of the election, is at least twenty-five years of age

stem: A Member of the House of Representatives may serve for no more than how many consecutive terms?
explanation: Article VI, Section 7 limits House Members to three consecutive three-year terms.
quote: No Member of the House of Representatives shall serve for more than three consecutive terms.

stem: Party-list representatives shall constitute what share of the total number of representatives, including those under the party list?
explanation: Article VI, Section 5(2) sets party-list representatives at twenty per centum of the total number of representatives.
quote: The party-list representatives shall constitute twenty per centum of the total number of representatives including those under the party list.

stem: Appropriation, revenue or tariff bills must originate exclusively in:
choices: the Department of Budget and Management
explanation: Article VI, Section 24 requires appropriation, revenue or tariff bills, among others, to originate exclusively in the House of Representatives, though the Senate may propose or concur with amendments.
quote: shall originate exclusively in the House of Representatives

stem: Under Article VI, Section 26, every bill passed by Congress shall embrace:
choices: the approval of the President beforehand
only one subject, expressed in its title
explanation: Section 26(1) of Article VI is the one-subject, one-title rule.
quote: Every bill passed by the Congress shall embrace only one subject which shall be expressed in the title thereof.

stem: To declare the existence of a state of war, Congress must vote by:
choices: a simple majority of the Senate
two-thirds of both Houses in joint session assembled, voting separately
three-fourths of all Members voting jointly
a majority of the House of Representatives
explanation: Article VI, Section 23(1) gives Congress the sole power to declare the existence of a state of war, by a vote of two-thirds of both Houses in joint session assembled, voting separately.
quote: by a vote of two-thirds of both Houses in joint session assembled, voting separately

stem: What is the minimum age requirement for President of the Philippines on the day of the election?
explanation: Article VII, Section 2 requires the President to be at least forty years of age on the day of the election.
quote: at least forty years of age on the day of the election

stem: Under the 1987 Constitution, the President:
choices: may run again after a six-year gap
is not eligible for any re-election
may serve up to twelve years
explanation: Article VII, Section 4 provides that the President shall not be eligible for any re-election.
quote: The President shall not be eligible for any re-election.

stem: A Vice-President may serve for no more than how many successive terms?
explanation: Article VII, Section 4 provides that no Vice-President shall serve for more than two successive terms.
quote: No Vice-President shall serve for more than two successive terms.

stem: The President may place the Philippines under martial law for a period not exceeding:
explanation: Article VII, Section 18 limits a proclamation of martial law or suspension of the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus to a period not exceeding sixty days, unless extended by Congress.
quote: for a period not exceeding sixty days

stem: Within how many hours after proclaiming martial law must the President submit a report to Congress?
explanation: Article VII, Section 18 requires the President to submit a report in person or in writing to Congress within forty-eight hours from the proclamation or suspension.
quote: within forty-eight hours

stem: If both the President and Vice-President die, are permanently disabled, are removed, or resign, who shall act as President?
explanation: Article VII, Section 8 provides that the President of the Senate or, in case of his inability, the Speaker of the House shall act as President until a President or Vice-President is elected and qualified.
quote: the President of the Senate or, in case of his inability, the Speaker of the House of Representatives, shall then act as President

stem: The President's power to grant reprieves, commutations, and pardons does NOT extend to:
explanation: Article VII, Section 19 allows the President to grant reprieves, commutations, pardons and remit fines and forfeitures after conviction by final judgment, except in cases of impeachment.
quote: Except in cases of impeachment

stem: For a treaty or international agreement to be valid and effective, it must be concurred in by at least:
choices: three-fourths of Congress in joint session
a majority of the House of Representatives
two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate
explanation: Article VII, Section 21 requires the concurrence of at least two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate.
quote: concurred in by at least two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate

stem: The Supreme Court is composed of a Chief Justice and how many Associate Justices?
explanation: Article VIII, Section 4(1) provides that the Supreme Court shall be composed of a Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices, fifteen members in all.
quote: composed of a Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices

stem: Members of the Supreme Court and judges of lower courts hold office during good behavior until they reach the age of:
explanation: Article VIII, Section 11 provides that they hold office during good behavior until they reach the age of seventy years or become incapacitated.
quote: until they reach the age of seventy years

stem: Cases filed before the Supreme Court must be decided within how long from the date of submission?
explanation: Article VIII, Section 15(1) sets twenty-four months for the Supreme Court, twelve months for lower collegiate courts, and three months for other lower courts.
quote: within twenty-four months from date of submission for the Supreme Court

stem: The Judicial and Bar Council, which recommends appointees to the Judiciary, is under the supervision of:
choices: the Integrated Bar of the Philippines
explanation: Article VIII, Section 8(1) creates the Judicial and Bar Council under the supervision of the Supreme Court.
quote: A Judicial and Bar Council is hereby created under the supervision of the Supreme Court

stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the independent Constitutional Commissions?
explanation: Article IX-A, Section 1 names only three independent Constitutional Commissions: the Civil Service Commission, the Commission on Elections, and the Commission on Audit. The Commission on Human Rights is created under Article XIII.
quote: The Constitutional Commissions, which shall be independent, are the Civil Service Commission, the Commission on Elections, and the Commission on Audit.

stem: The Civil Service Commission is composed of:
choices: five Commissioners with a rotating Chair
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 1(1) provides that the civil service shall be administered by the Civil Service Commission composed of a Chairman and two Commissioners.
quote: Civil Service Commission composed of a Chairman and two Commissioners

stem: The civil service embraces all branches, subdivisions, instrumentalities, and agencies of the Government, including government-owned or controlled corporations:
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(1) includes GOCCs with original charters. GOCCs incorporated under the general corporation law are outside the civil service.
quote: including government-owned or controlled corporations with original charters

stem: Appointments in the civil service shall be made only according to:
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(2) requires appointments according to merit and fitness, determined as far as practicable by competitive examination, with stated exceptions.
quote: Appointments in the civil service shall be made only according to merit and fitness

stem: Competitive examination is generally required for civil service appointments, EXCEPT for positions that are:
choices: policy-determining, primarily confidential, or highly technical
clerical, custodial, or in the trades
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(2) exempts positions which are policy-determining, primarily confidential, or highly technical from the competitive-examination requirement.
quote: except to positions which are policy-determining, primarily confidential, or highly technical

stem: Under the Constitution, an officer or employee of the civil service may be removed or suspended only:
choices: when the agency's budget is cut
upon the request of a superior
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(3) guarantees security of tenure: no officer or employee of the civil service shall be removed or suspended except for cause provided by law.
quote: No officer or employee of the civil service shall be removed or suspended except for cause provided by law.

stem: Civil service officers and employees are prohibited from engaging, directly or indirectly, in:
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(4) prohibits civil service officers and employees from engaging in any electioneering or partisan political campaign.
quote: No officer or employee in the civil service shall engage, directly or indirectly, in any electioneering or partisan political campaign.

stem: According to Article IX-B, the right to self-organization of government employees:
choices: requires CSC approval for each union
applies only to employees of GOCCs
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(5) states that the right to self-organization shall not be denied to government employees.
quote: The right to self-organization shall not be denied to government employees.

stem: A candidate who lost in an election may NOT be appointed to any government office within what period after the election?
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 6 bars losing candidates from appointment to any office in the Government, or any GOCC or its subsidiaries, within one year after the election.
quote: No candidate who has lost in any election, shall within one year after such election, be appointed to any office in the Government

stem: Unless specifically authorized by law, an elective or appointive public officer or employee may NOT receive:
choices: overtime pay approved by the agency
explanation: Article IX-B, Section 8 prohibits additional, double, or indirect compensation unless specifically authorized by law.
quote: No elective or appointive public officer or employee shall receive additional, double, or indirect compensation, unless specifically authorized by law

stem: The Commission on Elections is composed of a Chairman and how many Commissioners?
explanation: Article IX-C, Section 1(1) provides for a Chairman and six Commissioners. The CSC and COA each have a Chairman and two Commissioners.
quote: composed of a Chairman and six Commissioners

stem: For purposes of the three-term limit of local elective officials, voluntary renunciation of the office:
choices: is not considered an interruption in the continuity of service
disqualifies the official from running for the same office again
is allowed only once and counts as one full term served
is considered an interruption, so the term count starts again
explanation: Article X, Section 8 provides that voluntary renunciation of the office for any length of time shall not be considered an interruption in the continuity of service.
quote: Voluntary renunciation of the office for any length of time shall not be considered as an interruption in the continuity of his service for the full term for which he was elected.

stem: Article XI, Section 1 of the Constitution declares that public office is a:
explanation: Article XI, Section 1 states that public office is a public trust, and that public officers must at all times be accountable to the people.
quote: Public office is a public trust.

stem: Which of the following officials is NOT removable by impeachment?
choices: A Member of the Supreme Court
explanation: Article XI, Section 2 lists the impeachable officers: the President, the Vice-President, the Members of the Supreme Court, the Members of the Constitutional Commissions, and the Ombudsman.
quote: The President, the Vice-President, the Members of the Supreme Court, the Members of the Constitutional Commissions, and the Ombudsman may be removed from office on impeachment

stem: Which body has the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment?
explanation: Article XI, Section 3(1) gives the House of Representatives the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment. The Senate tries and decides them.
quote: The House of Representatives shall have the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment.

stem: Which body has the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment?
explanation: Article XI, Section 3(6) gives the Senate the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment.
quote: The Senate shall have the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment.

stem: No impeachment proceedings shall be initiated against the same official more than once within a period of:
explanation: Article XI, Section 3(5) bars initiating impeachment proceedings against the same official more than once within a period of one year.
quote: No impeachment proceedings shall be initiated against the same official more than once within a period of one year.

stem: Upon assumption of office, a public officer or employee must submit a declaration under oath of their:
explanation: Article XI, Section 17 requires a declaration under oath of assets, liabilities, and net worth upon assumption of office and as often as required by law, the basis of the SALN.
quote: submit a declaration under oath of his assets, liabilities, and net worth

stem: Under the 1987 Constitution, the Ombudsman is also known as the:
explanation: Article XI, Section 5 creates the Office of the Ombudsman, "composed of the Ombudsman to be known as Tanodbayan." The Sandiganbayan is a separate anti-graft court.
quote: composed of the Ombudsman to be known as Tanodbayan

stem: Corporations allowed to enter into co-production, joint venture, or production-sharing agreements for natural resources must be at least what percent owned by Filipino citizens?
explanation: Article XII, Section 2 refers to corporations or associations at least sixty per centum of whose capital is owned by Filipino citizens.
quote: at least sixty per centum of whose capital is owned by such citizens

stem: According to the Constitution, the national language of the Philippines is:
explanation: Article XIV, Section 6 states that the national language of the Philippines is Filipino. Filipino and English are the official languages (Section 7).
quote: The national language of the Philippines is Filipino.

stem: For purposes of communication and instruction, the official languages of the Philippines are:
choices: Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, Spanish
Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, English
English and, until otherwise provided by law, Filipino
Filipino and English, with the regional languages as auxiliary official languages
explanation: Article XIV, Section 7 makes Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, English the official languages. Regional languages are auxiliary official languages in the regions.
quote: the official languages of the Philippines are Filipino and, until otherwise provided by law, English

stem: Under Article XIV, Section 5, the State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to:
explanation: Article XIV, Section 5(5) directs the State to assign the highest budgetary priority to education.
quote: The State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to education

stem: According to the Constitution, the flag of the Philippines shall be red, white, and blue, with:
explanation: Article XVI, Section 1 describes the flag as red, white, and blue, with a sun and three stars, as consecrated and honored by the people and recognized by law.
quote: red, white, and blue, with a sun and three stars

stem: "The State may not be sued without its consent" expresses the doctrine of:
explanation: Article XVI, Section 3 embodies the doctrine of state immunity: the State may not be sued without its consent.
quote: The State may not be sued without its consent.

stem: Article XV, Section 1 recognizes which institution as the foundation of the nation?
explanation: Article XV, Section 1 states that the State recognizes the Filipino family as the foundation of the nation.
quote: The State recognizes the Filipino family as the foundation of the nation.

stem: Congress, acting as a constituent assembly, may propose amendments to the Constitution upon a vote of:
choices: a majority of all its Members
explanation: Article XVII, Section 1 allows amendments or revisions to be proposed by Congress upon a vote of three-fourths of all its Members, or by a constitutional convention.
quote: upon a vote of three-fourths of all its Members

stem: Amendments through people's initiative require a petition of at least what percentage of the total number of registered voters?
explanation: Article XVII, Section 2 requires a petition of at least twelve per centum of all registered voters, with every legislative district represented by at least three per centum of its registered voters.
quote: at least twelve per centum of the total number of registered voters

stem: Under Article XIII, which body is created to investigate all forms of human rights violations involving civil and political rights?
choices: The Office of the Solicitor General
explanation: Article XIII, Sections 17 and 18 create the independent Commission on Human Rights and empower it to investigate all forms of human rights violations involving civil and political rights.
quote: Investigate, on its own or on complaint by any party, all forms of human rights violations involving civil and political rights
